payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones

decision.question: Comparing the source and edited images, is the source mug visibly positioned to the right of the same headphones, is there reliable evidence that no relevant progress occurred, or is the result unresolved?
decision.criteria: Pass only when visual evidence reliably establishes that the source mug itself is now positioned to the right of the same headphones. Compare the source mug’s distinctive light-blue color, large body, and handle shape with edited mugs, allowing for changes in appearance, scale, and lighting. Fail only when evidence reliably establishes that no relevant progress toward moving the source mug occurred. Do not count a right-side mug alone as progress or fulfillment. A source-location blur or residue counts as evidence of attempted movement only if its shape and appearance reliably connect it to the source mug; an ambiguous color-like blur, unrelated or newly generated mugs, or uncertain identity does not establish progress. Use unknown when the evidence cannot establish fulfillment or no progress.
decision.binding: Compare the source image’s large light-blue mug, including its body and handle, with each mug in the edited image; compare the same headphones across images and assess whether the source mug is to their right. Inspect the source mug’s former location for residue, but distinguish a visibly mug-shaped remnant corresponding to the source mug from an indistinct blur or artifact. Do not assume that a different-looking right-side mug is the source mug.
